author: mumuyouming

Title: 99 on Metacritic? A Masterpiece of Technology, Not Game Design.
As only the second game in history to receive a 99 on Metacritic, GTA VI is supposed to represent the absolute pinnacle of gaming. Yet beyond its stunning visuals and industry-leading production values, I struggle to find a single groundbreaking design decision that actually justifies such an extraordinary score.What's even more disappointing is that, in some respects, the level of detail doesn't even match Red Dead Redemption 2, a game Rockstar released years ago. It genuinely makes me wonder what Rockstar has been doing all this time.Instead of delivering meaningful gameplay innovation, GTA VI often feels like an endless sequence of meticulously scripted events and predetermined cinematic moments. Everything looks spectacular, but how much of it actually translates into a better gaming experience?And don't even get me started on the new wanted ****'s genuinely infuriating. Committing a crime has become so tedious and time-consuming that simply obeying the law feels like the more rewarding option. Want to steal a car? Great. Now you have to change your clothes, swap your face covering, repaint your vehicle, and spend ages shaking off the **** that just to steal a damn car in a game called Grand Theft **** what point did Rockstar forget that this is supposed to be a video game?Realism should serve gameplay, not the other way around. When the pursuit of realism starts actively undermining player freedom, pacing, and enjoyment, you've completely missed the point.Games should be judged by how well they play, not by how convincingly they imitate **** breathtaking graphics and extreme realism are all it takes to earn a near-perfect score, then everyone's real life deserves a 100 on **** VI is undoubtedly a technical achievement. But technical excellence does not automatically equal great game design, and an astronomical budget does not make a game **** the end of the day, GTA VI is an overproduced, overhyped, and fundamentally disappointing game that has been praised into the stratosphere by a gaming media seemingly more impressed by technological spectacle than actual gameplay.99/100? What a joke.
